responsibility: Defines the z/TPF-specific machine patterns used primarily for TPF tracing/profiling hooks in function prologues and epilogues. It adds UNSPEC-based RTL patterns that emit the low-level trace-check-and-branch instruction sequences when TARGET_TPF_PROFILING is enabled, complementing the generic s390 machine description with TPF-only code generation.
same_name_distinction: Within the tpf same-name group, this file is the RTL machine-description supplement that defines the actual prologue_tpf and epilogue_tpf instruction patterns used when TPF profiling is enabled. Unlike tpf.h it does not set OS macros/specs, and unlike tpf.opt it does not declare the switches controlling those hooks.
